entries.en: just like; as if; exactly so.

entries.zh: 这样、如此（比拟之词；原件汉字与对音不合，暂依词头作“如此”解）。
entries.en: thus, like this (per the headword; the Chinese characters do not match the recorded reading).
entries.notes: 「掌才」与 como/así 语义不合，疑为记音借字，释义存疑。

entries.en: How dare I?; I would not presume.
What is your name? (polite, addressed to Vm.)
entries.notes: 「v.」为 Vm.（Vuestra merced）之省；「呌也名」当读作「叫乜名」。

entries.zh: 问候安好：“纳福吗？”（问起居康健）
entries.en: Are you well? (greeting; lit. 'do you enjoy blessings?')
entries.notes: 首字「差人」及末字漫漶，据「納福」定为问候套语。

entries.en: What is to be done?; how so?
entries.notes: 词头 como que está 语义含混，汉字「奈何」与对音一致，取“如何、怎奈”义。

entries.zh: 近来怎样？／别来如何？（问候近况）
entries.en: How have things been with you? (greeting)
entries.notes: 「幾時伺樣」与 R 栏对音不合、末字污损，仅据词头定为问候近况，具体套语存疑。

entries.en: Is your health good? (polite greeting)
entries.notes: 「幾体」疑为「貴體」之讹，R 栏 gùi tỷ 可证。

entries.zh: 尊夫人可好？（尊壺／尊閫，敬称人妻）
entries.en: How is your wife? (polite)
entries.notes: 「壺」疑为「閫」之讹；词头 V.a muger 明指妻室。

entries.en: as you please; according to your wish.
as you wish; at your own discretion.
entries.notes: 词头末「aualue drio」当作 albedrío（意愿），汉语「主張」与之相合。

entries.zh: 便利、安适；安身的位置（位：坐落之处）。
entries.en: comfort, convenience; a convenient place or position.

entries.zh: 号哭、哀号（因怜悯而痛哭）。
entries.en: to wail, cry out loud (in pity or grief).
to pity, have compassion.
entries.notes: M 栏 līm bīn 即「憐憫」连读，汉字栏仅存「憫」。

entries.zh: 悲戚、哀怜（戚／慼：哀痛、忧伤）。
entries.en: to grieve with; sorrow, sympathy.
entries.notes: 「戚」疑为「慼」，字迹污损、仅存单字，释义据字义与词头推定。

entries.en: compassion; sorrowful, grieved.
entries.notes: 字迹污损、对音作 chey..，语义据单字与词头 compadecerse 推定。

entries.zh: 互相怜惜、彼此疼惜（相痛）。
entries.en: to sympathize with each other; mutual compassion.
to pity, have compassion (also rendered kělián).
entries.notes: M 栏 co līng／co līn 即「可憐」异记，与「矜」互训。

entries.en: pitiable; to feel pain for someone.
to grieve for; to feel another's pain.
to have compassion for; to relieve, sympathize.
entries.notes: M、R 两栏对音歧出（līn/hīn、hiùn/hùn），字义据「恤」定。
